comment: Reputation chains (issue #20): the Argent Dawn, Cenarion Circle, Timbermaw Hold, Thorium Brotherhood and Hydraxian Waterlords quests that both factions take and that need no raid. Zandalar needs Zul'Gurub (E5). Chains only. Rules: tools/select_codas.py.

chains.name: Argent Dawn
chains.summary: 12 quests for Argent Dawn at required levels 50 to 60. The quests start with Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff, Caretaker Alen, Lord Maxwell Tyrosus and 6 more.

chains.name: Cenarion Circle
chains.summary: 34 quests for Cenarion Circle at required levels 54 to 60. The quests start with Beetix Ficklespragg, Windcaller Proudhorn, Noggle Ficklespragg and 11 more.

chains.name: Timbermaw Hold
chains.summary: 10 quests for Timbermaw Hold at required levels 45 to 50. The quests start with Grazle, Nafien, Salfa and 2 more.

chains.name: Thorium Brotherhood
chains.summary: 7 quests for Thorium Brotherhood at required level 45. The quests start with Master Smith Burninate, Hansel Heavyhands.

chains.name: Hydraxian Waterlords
chains.summary: 3 quests for Hydraxian Waterlords at required levels 55 to 56. The quests start with Duke Hydraxis.
